create.title: Hard-M1 t=1 residual Fejer tangent-gcd reduction and bounded-height sector
create.statement_tex: Fix real X>=2, one literal middle or lower hard-M1 residual shell L>=2, sigma in {+1,-1}, and fixed B>0. Let c_(N,sigma)^rem be the exact zero-extended Round-184 no-pair plus selected-neither/both coefficient, R_0=ceil(L), and H_B=floor((log(2X))^B). Its full-line sliding energy obeys the endpoint-exact even-parity connector E_R<=2D+4 Re C_R^(2), with terminal coefficient 4/R for odd R and 8/R for even R, diagonal D<<_epsilon L^2X^epsilon, and scalar Cauchy prefactor O(L) at R_0. Opening both endpoint coefficients at an even shift multiplicity-one, with a=d'-d and b=m'-m, gives r=db+am+ab and chi_4(d')chi_4(d)=(-1)^(a/2). The complete monotone sector has O(L^2) incidences. On either opposing orientation, the original gcd g and inward cross gcd kappa have the joint normal form r=2 kappa g h on the primitive domain kappa,g,h,U,v>0, kappa,g,U odd, (gU,v)=1, (U,h)=1, and 0<2 kappa g h<R_0. For fixed (kappa,g,h) there are O(L^2/(kappa g)) incidences per orientation, so the monotone sector together with both opposing sectors h<=H_B has absolute contribution O_(B,epsilon)(L^2X^epsilon). Canonical least-residue anchors, the separate U=1 convention, and the positive oriented affine index sets give an exact multiplicity-one one-outer-real-part complement with both orientations and h>H_B. On Y<h<=2Y its positive capacity is O(YL^2X^epsilon); the uniform O(L^2X^epsilon) signed estimate is open and requires a global factor Y. Bare affine alternation, rowwise Abel, O(1) per row with positive recombination, positive transform estimates, alias energy, and conductor centering do not supply that factor. This node proves only the strict finite reduction and bounded-height physical sector; it proves no complete t=1 residual, complete small-t owner, parent, bridge, theorem, or exponent.
create.next_action: Use the exact canonical h>H_B complement only. Prove the one-outer-real-part dyadic signed relation uniformly for every Y>H_B with both orientations, row labels, endpoint selectors, zero extensions, signs, and literal fields still coupled, gaining the full positive-capacity factor Y. Do not substitute rowwise Abel, O(1) per row, positive transform recombination, or selector-blind alternation.
